verses.t: “Ahu tuyhaṁ pure saddhā, sā te ajja na vijjati; Yaṁ tuyhaṁ tuyhamevetaṁ, natthi duccaritaṁ mama.
Aniccā hi calā saddhā, evaṁ diṭṭhā hi sā mayā; Rajjantipi virajjanti, tattha kiṁ jiyyate muni.
Paccati munino bhattaṁ, Thokaṁ thokaṁ kule kule; Piṇḍikāya carissāmi, Atthi jaṅghabalaṁ mamā”ti. … Sāṭimattiyo thero ….
